result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. One clear visual defect: the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' list is truncated mid-word ('Tokumaru Rameı') without an ellipsis, despite ample free space before the rating on the same row.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' under the first 'Popular right now' card is hard-clipped to 'Tokumaru Rameı' — the final letter is cut off mid-glyph with no ellipsis, even though there is plenty of empty space between the title and the '4.8 (500+)' rating on the same line. This looks like the title container has an incorrect fixed/max width or overflow clipping.
issues.suggestion: Let the title flex to fill available width (e.g., flex: 1 with min-width: 0) and use text-overflow: ellipsis for genuine overflow so names are never hard-clipped mid-character.
